answer: Weight each identity only after it seals its own opal — a dense multi-gigabyte replica whose layered bytes bind to its key through slow sequential hashing no clone can dedupe or share. Each epoch the protocol reopens random byte offsets as a plume of live audits the key answers alone, so a farm of N fakes must seal and hold N separate replicas, each marooned on its own island of storage, never one copy. Each added clone costs fresh non-dedupable storage no coalition can manufacture per alias; settlement re-runs the audits and burns the collateral behind any replica that misses a challenge.
